clause_i.reason: The task is stationary during a delay: an observation-free policy can wait or no-op and then make the same visible correction, because no delayed action must be chosen from changing task-state evidence. Thus there is a valid action-history-only policy for the static opportunity rather than the required failure of clause (i).

clause_ii.reason: Considered independently, the persistent TARGET and CURRENT renders in one screenshot are enough to select a corrective rule edit, so a bounded visual window can supply the information. It does not predict any autonomous evolution and therefore cannot establish real time together with the other clauses.

clause_iii.reason: With no new action, the current configuration, layout geometry, and target raster do not change. setProperty, reorder, and revert mutate state only inside synchronous input handlers, so no available correction becomes unavailable or strictly less effective within any positive delay; the only CSS transition is a non-task hover style.
